summary: Tested NEW Yann paywall logic. Created /app/backend/tests/test_yann_paywall.py with 14 tests (8 pure unit tests on services.yann_access.is_yann_allowed covering all 6 branches incl. expired trial + missing company_doc, + 6 integration tests). All 24 tests pass (10 existing test_yann.py + 14 new) in 16.87s. UNIT: BETA→beta, trial(future)→trial, trial(past)→expired, suspended→no_subscription, pro→pro, addon→addon, low+no-addon→plan_too_low, None company_doc→plan_too_low. INTEGRATION: (1) Live server with BETA_MODE=True: GET /api/yann/quota returns allowed=true, access_reason='beta', limit=30. (2) BETA_MODE=False monkey-patched on services.yann_access AND deps (critical — deps.ensure_company would otherwise force plan=pro back) — verified via in-process ASGITransport client: suspended→402 detail={code:'yann_paywall', reason:'no_subscription', message}; trial(future)→quota allowed=true reason='trial'; plan=pro→reason='pro'; plan=trial+addon=True→reason='addon'; plan=trial+no addon→402 reason='plan_too_low'. No real LLM calls were made for the paywall scenarios (blocked cases return 402 before LLM; allowed cases verified via GET /quota which exposes the same allowed/access_reason fields). Company doc snapshotted & restored via replace_one — verified post-test state matches pre-test (plan=pro, subscription_status=active, expires 2036).

minor.issue: When subscription_expires_at is None the helper returns False, causing a trial without expiry date to be reported as 'expired'. The branch comment in the docstring says 'None = sans limite' but the code returns False. Either fix code to treat None as future, or update docstring. Cosmetic for current usage (trial always has expiry).

action_items: Optional: fix docstring/behavior mismatch in services/yann_access.py:_is_future for None expires_at.

Consider extracting BETA_MODE access via `db.BETA_MODE` attribute lookup (instead of `from db import BETA_MODE`) in deps.py and services/yann_access.py — this would make the flag dynamically togglable without dual-module monkey-patching (useful for ops/tests).
critical_code_review_comments: is_yann_allowed is well-factored, returns precise reason codes, and is unit-testable in isolation (no DB calls). 6 documented branches all reachable.
Order of checks is correct: BETA → trial → suspended → pro → addon → fallback (plan_too_low). Suspended properly short-circuits before pro/addon — verified.
POST /api/yann/chat now returns the spec-compliant 402 with detail={code:'yann_paywall', reason, message} — confirmed in integration test.
GET /api/yann/quota now exposes `allowed` and `access_reason` — enables UI to show the right CTA without invoking the LLM.
Re-evaluating paywall on every call (not just at session start) is correct — upgrades take effect immediately.

ARCHITECTURE NOTE: `from db import BETA_MODE` creates a snapshot reference in both deps.py and services/yann_access.py. Toggling db.BETA_MODE at runtime won't propagate — tests work around this by patching both modules. Not a bug, but worth knowing for ops.
seed_data_creation: No persistent test data created. Integration tests snapshot the cousin-entreprise-7c4e44 company doc, mutate it during the test (plan/subscription_status/yann_addon_active), and restore via replace_one in fixture teardown. Verified post-run that the company is back to plan=pro, subscription_status=active, expires 2036.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Yann paywall is implemented and verified across all 6 branches. test_yann_paywall.py uses two strategies: (a) pure unit tests with monkeypatch on ya_module.BETA_MODE for the is_yann_allowed function, (b) in-process ASGITransport client with BETA_MODE patched on BOTH services.yann_access AND deps modules — necessary because deps.ensure_company would otherwise reset plan=pro/active on every auth call when BETA_MODE is True. The live preview server still has BETA_MODE=True so end-users currently get 'beta' access. No regressions in existing test_yann.py.
